description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ReportGeneratorServiceTest' for testing the 'ReportGeneratorService' in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup code, mock objects, and test methods that verify various functionalities like report identification, header definition retrieval, and report data normalization.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the various methods of the ReportGeneratorService in the OrangeHRM Core Service module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of ReportGeneratorService, and populates test data from YAML fixtures.

methods.name: testIsPimReport
methods.description: Tests whether the report with ID 5 is identified as a PIM report, and that ID 100 is not.

methods.name: testGetHeaderDefinitionByReportId
methods.description: Mocks the I18NHelper and ReportGeneratorService to verify that header definition retrieval by report ID is correct.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedReportData
methods.description: Verifies that normalized report data and count match expected values for report ID 5.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedReportDataForPastEmployees
methods.description: Verifies normalized report data and count for a different report ID 6, representing past employees.
